summary_ja: 湖羊の仔羊における下痢および抗菌薬投与が腸内細菌叢と薬剤耐性遺伝子（ARG）に与える影響を調べるため、メタゲノム解析を実施した。健常群、下痢初期群、および複数抗菌薬治療後の下痢回復後期群から糞便検体を採取し、メタゲノム組立てゲノム（MAG）を復元した。下痢初期には共生菌の病原性関連遺伝子の濃縮が見られたのに対し、抗菌薬治療後の回復後期ではリンコサミド系やセファロスポリン系に対するARGの持続的な濃縮が確認された。菌群構造の全体的な変動は下痢自体よりも抗菌薬による感受性菌の排除が主因であることが示唆された。
summary_en: This metagenomic study investigated the dynamics of fecal microbial communities and antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in Hu sheep lambs during diarrhea and following antibiotic combination therapy. Metagenomic binning reconstructed 482 high-quality MAGs, revealing that antibiotic treatment induced significant shifts in microbial composition and led to persistent enrichment of cephalosporin- and lincosamide-related ARGs. Antibiotic-driven clearance of sensitive bacteria was identified as the primary factor driving the altered microbial structure in the recovery stage.
key_finding_ja: 仔羊の下痢に対する複数抗菌薬の投与は、腸内細菌叢の構造を大きく変化させ、特定薬剤の耐性遺伝子を持続的に増加させる。
why_it_matters_ja: 家畜での抗菌薬使用に伴う薬剤耐性遺伝子の残存リスクを考慮した、適切な腸内微生態の管理および治療戦略の最適化が求められる。

title: Neuroimmune treatment of advanced solid tumors: 3-year survival after angiotensin 1-7, pineal indoles, and cannabinoids.
abstract: In a recent study, the exogenous administration of angiotensin 1-7 (Ang 1,7) together with melatonin, 5-methoxytryptamine, and cannabidiol increased 1-year survival in advanced cancer patients, underlining the utility of neuromodulation in oncology. We now report a single-arm interventional study to evaluate the effectiveness of introducing Ang 1-7 in the neuroimmune regime, including pineal indoles and cannabinoids. Two cohorts of patients with advanced solid tumors refractory to standard oncologic treatments and with an estimated life expectancy of less than six months were studied. The full neuroimmune regimen cohort consisted of 100 consecutive patients treated over the last three years with Ang 1-7, pineal indoles, and cannabinoids, while the comparator cohort included 212 consecutive patients treated between 2015 and 2019 with pineal indoles and cannabinoids alone. Gastroprotected capsules of Ang 1-7 coupled with cyclodextrin were administered at 0.5 mg p.o. twice/day. Melatonin (100 mg) and 5-methoxytryptamine (20 mg) were given p.o. at bedtime and in the early afternoon, respectively. Cannabidiol or cannabigerol (in the case of glioblastoma) was given at 20 mg p.o. twice/day. Clinical response, disease control, and overall survival, along with the lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio, were evaluated. In the full regimen cohort, disease control was achieved in 67 of 100 patients, with objective tumor regression observed in 23%. In the comparator cohort, disease control was obtained in 111 of 212 patients, with objective regression in 8%. Three-year overall survival was significantly higher in the full regimen cohort (37%) compared with the comparator cohort (19%). Both treatments were associated with a significant increase in the lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio, suggesting an improvement in systemic immune status. The addition of Ang 1-7 to a neuroimmune regimen combining pineal indoles and cannabinoids was associated with improved disease control and long-term survival in patients with end-stage solid tumors lacking effective therapeutic options.
authors: Lissoni P, Monzon A, Marroccoli S, Di Fede G, Sassola A, Messina G, Simoes-E-Silva AC, Kuznetsova IV, Burchakov DI, Kirillova MY, Cardinali DP.
screening_reason: Evaluates a clinical neuroimmune therapeutic regimen modulating nervous-immune interactions for advanced solid tumors.
summary_ja: 標準治療に抵抗性を示す進行性固形癌患者を対象に、アンジオテンシン1-7（Ang 1-7）、松果体インドール、およびカンナビノイドを組み合わせた神経免疫療法の効果を評価した。Ang 1-7を含むフル処方群（100例）と過去の比較群（212例）を比較した結果、病勢コントロール率および3年全生存率がフル処方群で有意に高かった。両群においてリンパ球/単球比の著明な上昇が見られ、全身性免疫状態の改善が示唆された。
summary_en: This single-arm study investigated a neuroimmune regimen combining angiotensin 1-7 (Ang 1-7), pineal indoles, and cannabinoids in 100 patients with advanced solid tumors compared to a historical control of 212 patients. The full regimen achieved higher disease control rates and a significantly improved 3-year overall survival rate (37% vs 19%). Both cohorts demonstrated an increased lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio, pointing to improved systemic immune status.
key_finding_ja: 松果体インドールとカンナビノイドにアンジオテンシン1-7を加えた神経免疫療法は、進行性固形癌患者の3年全生存率を有意に向上させた。
why_it_matters_ja: 難治性の末期固形癌に対する新たな神経免疫学的治療アプローチの可能性が示されているが、今後の臨床試験による検証が必要である。

title: Disruption of hippocampal mitochondrial function underlies opioid-induced postoperative cognitive dysfunction in aged rats.
abstract: Postoperative cognitive dysfunction (POCD) is a common and persistent complication in aging individuals following surgery, particularly when opioids are used for perioperative pain management. Although opioids are widely administered in the perioperative setting, the mechanisms by which they contribute to long-term cognitive impairment remain poorly understood. Here, using an aged rat model of surgery with perioperative morphine administration, we investigated how synaptic, axonal, and mitochondrial abnormalities contribute to persistent hippocampal memory deficits, and evaluated therapeutic strategies targeting neuroinflammation and mitochondrial dysfunction. We found that these memory impairments were not attributable to systemic illness or gross dendritic degeneration. Instead, surgery and morphine-treated animals exhibited selective reductions in dendritic spine subtypes associated with synaptic stability, impaired late-phase long-term potentiation, and blunted experience-dependent upregulation of the AMPA receptor subunit GluA1. These synaptic alterations were accompanied by elevated circulating neurofilament light chain (Nf-L), indicating sustained axonal perturbation. Surgery and morphine treatment also produced persistent hippocampal mitochondrial dysfunction, characterized by impaired oxidative phosphorylation, reduced respiratory reserve capacity, and increased DNA oxidation. These effects were not observed in liver tissue, arguing against a widespread mitochondrial deficit. Pharmacological inhibition of central TLR4 signaling at the time of surgery, which previously rescued the memory deficit, attenuated oxidative stress and partially restored mitochondrial function, implicating early neuroinflammatory signaling in the development of long-term mitochondrial impairment. Finally, targeted mitochondrial rejuvenation with SS-31 four weeks post-surgery robustly rescued hippocampal-dependent memory and normalized mitochondrial respiratory function despite persistently elevated DNA oxidation and Nf-L. Together these findings identify sustained hippocampal mitochondrial dysfunction as a key mechanistic substrate underlying long-term cognitive deficits following surgery and morphine exposure in aged rats, and highlight mitochondrial bioenergetics as a promising therapeutic target for POCD.
authors: Muscat SM, Deems NP, Alvarez BD, Butler MJ, Gonzalez Olmo BM, Kolonay DW, Sanders HF, Scaria EA, Mackey-Alfonso SE, Blackwell JA, DeMarsh JW, Bettes MN, Quach TT, Cortese GP, Glasper ER, Leuner B, Baskin KK, Barrientos RM.
screening_reason: Examines the contribution of central neuroinflammatory signaling and mitochondrial dysfunction to postoperative cognitive deficits.
summary_ja: 手術および周術期のモルヒネ投与は高齢患者における術後認知機能障害（POCD）を引き起こす要因となるが、その持続的な機序は不明な点が多い。本研究では高齢ラットモデルを用いて、周術期のモルヒネ投与と手術が海馬のシナプス変化およびミトコンドリア機能障害を引き起こすことを示した。手術時のTLR4シグナル阻害は酸化ストレスを軽減しミトコンドリア機能を部分的に回復させた。さらに、術後4週時点でのSS-31によるミトコンドリア再生療法は海馬依存性記憶と呼吸機能を効果的に改善させた。
summary_en: Using an aged rat model, this study investigated how perioperative morphine exposure and surgery drive persistent hippocampal memory deficits via mitochondrial dysfunction. Surgery and morphine led to reduced synaptic stability, impaired LTP, and persistent mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation deficits in the hippocampus. Early TLR4 inhibition or late targeted mitochondrial rejuvenation using SS-31 effectively restored mitochondrial function and rescued memory performance.
key_finding_ja: 高齢ラットにおいて、周術期のモルヒネ投与と手術による海馬ミトコンドリアの持続的機能障害が術後認知機能低下の主要なメカニズムであることが示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 周術期の神経炎症やミトコンドリア生体エネルギーの回復を標的とすることが、高齢者の術後認知機能障害に対する新たな治療戦略となる可能性がある。

title: Microbial Diversity Estimation and Hill Number Calculation Using the Hierarchical Pitman-Yor Process.
abstract: Background The human microbiome comprises the microorganisms that inhabit the various locales of the human body and plays a vital role in human health. The composition of a microbial population is often quantified through measures of species diversity, which summarize the number of species along with their relative abundances into a single value. In a finite microbiome sample, there will be species missing from the target population, which will affect the diversity estimates. Methods We employ a model based on the hierarchical Pitman-Yor (HPY) process to model the species abundance distributions over multiple populations. The model parameters are estimated using a Gibbs sampler. We also derive estimates of species diversity, conditional and unconditional on the observed data, as a function of the HPY parameters. Finally, we derive a general formula for the Hill numbers in the HPY context. Results We show that the Gibbs sampler for the HPY model performs well in simulations. We also show that the conditional estimates of diversity from the HPY model improve over naïve estimates when species are missing. Similarly, the conditional HPY estimates tend to perform better than the naïve estimates especially when the number of individuals sampled from a population is small. Finally, we illustrate results of applying the HPY model in an infant gut microbiome dataset.
authors: McGregor K, Parsons T, Simons E, Scott J, Kozyrskyj A, Quince C.
screening_reason: Develops statistical methodology tailored specifically for calculating diversity and Hill numbers in human gut microbiome datasets.
summary_ja: 本研究では、複数の微生物群集における種豊度分布をモデル化するため、階層的ピットマン・ヨー（HPY）プロセスに基づく統計手法を提案した。ギブスサンプラーを用いてパラメータを推定し、未観察種が存在する場合やサンプルサイズが小さい場合における多様性推定量やヒル数の算出方法を導出した。シミュレーションおよび乳幼児の腸内細菌叢データセットへの適用により、従来法に対する推定精度の向上が示された。
summary_en: The authors developed a statistical approach using the hierarchical Pitman-Yor (HPY) process to model species abundance and estimate microbial diversity and Hill numbers. Estimated via a Gibbs sampler, the HPY model improved diversity estimation over naive approaches, particularly with small sample sizes or missing species. The utility of the method was demonstrated on an infant gut microbiome dataset.
key_finding_ja: 階層的ピットマン・ヨー（HPY）プロセスに基づく統計モデルにより、サンプルサイズが小さい場合でも正確な微生物多様性推定およびヒル数算出が可能となる。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸内細菌叢をはじめとする微生物解析において、欠損種の影響を抑えた高精度な多様性評価手法として活用されることが期待される。
